description: React component for a notifications panel page that displays user notifications, allows marking them as read, filtering, and loading state handling.

methods.name: fetchNotifications
methods.description: Fetches notifications from API or fallback data, updates component state.

methods.name: handleMarkRead
methods.description: Marks a notification as read locally and via API.

methods.name: handleMarkAllRead
methods.description: Marks all notifications as read locally and via API.

methods.name: formatTime
methods.description: Formats ISO timestamp into a relative time string.
